description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ProviderAPI class in the OpenID Authentication plugin, specifically testing API endpoints such as create, getOne, getAll, delete, and update within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: ProviderAPITest

methods.description: Tests retrieving all provider records via the API.
